'''Virtual Original''' is the [[Players Committee]] Virtual-card era from the first Virtual Set through the [[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]]. The first set became tournament-legal on 9 March 2002.<ref name="decivs1">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020610072829/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/playerscommittee/virtualcardset1.html Virtual Card Set #1 is Away!], decipher.com (Wayback, 10 June 2002 snapshot; dated 5 March 2002)</ref> Printable overlays are [[V-slips]]. The full constructed pool is [[Premiere - Original VS17]].

== Sets ==

The program issued numbered Virtual Sets 1 through 17 plus [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]]. Legal days and PDF rows are on [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]. Tiles: [[Main Page#Virtual Original (2002–2009)|Main Page]]. Cancelled Fifth Anthology / Galaxy At War: [[Cancelled Virtual Sets]].

== Organized play ==

Players Committee World Championships from 2002 through 2008 used this virtual pool.<ref name="list">[[List of SWCCG tournaments]]</ref> Cutoffs are titled [[Premiere - Original VS1|Premiere - Original VS{N}]].

== Online play ==

[[Holotable]] was the downloaded virtual tabletop for this era.<ref name="ringer">[https://www.theringer.com/2018/5/21/17374528/star-wars-customizable-card-game-player-community The Force Is Strong With This 'Star Wars' Subculture], Ben Lindbergh, ''The Ringer'', 21 May 2018. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20180523173054/https://www.theringer.com/2018/5/21/17374528/star-wars-customizable-card-game-player-community Internet Archive]</ref>

== Rules ==

The era's consolidated rules book from 2007 is [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1]]. The Players Committee rules page linked that PDF in July and September 2009.<ref name="pcrules2009">[https://web.archive.org/web/20090706102757/http://www.starwarsccg.org/rules/ Rules], starwarsccg.org (Wayback, 6 July 2009)</ref> From 2002 until that book, play used Decipher [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0|Rulebook 2.0]], [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]], the [[Decipher Glossary Supplement]], and the January 2003 [[Players Committee Rules Supplement (2003)|Players Committee Rules Supplement]].

== End of the era ==

In 2009 the Players Committee regrouped the numbered sets into Virtual Blocks.<ref name="blockreorg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf VirtualBlock1.pdf] (official text as of 7 December 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> That change opened the [[Virtual Legacy]] era. Event page: [[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]].
